The shafts then are taken and matched to the heads with modern adhesives and the old style pinned hosel to be sure the head and shaft are married together properly. After finishing the shaft the leather grip is hand wrapped on to give you, the player, the classic feel of a leather grip. products.title: Hickory Shafts for Woods
products.body_html:
We source our hickory from a supplier in Tennessee that was supplying hickory to the manufactures back in the 20s & 30s.  We take in hickory boards, then painstakingly turn them into dowels, which we check for zero imperfections (wormholes, knots, etc.), strength and straightness of grain.  We then sonically test the shafts using our proprietary process.  Finally, we run these selected shafts through our custom wood lathe, sorting them for stiffness, which allows us to categorize them for flexibility.  This ensures we can customize our clubs and sets to your exacting specifications. It's a key reason why the best players in the hickory game today request our shafts for their use in play.

Shaft Length   44" Max

products.title: Star OA Complete RH Hickory Iron Set (9 Clubs)
products.body_html:
This set is our replica of McGregor's OA classic set, first introduced circa 1915-1917.  The original set is very collectable because it featured wide flange soles, which puts the weight in the bottom of the club head.  This, in turn, helps players get the ball in the air, which is a particular concern for American golfers and others who play frequently on parkland style courses.  Sometime around 1928, McGregor expanded its original short set to nine clubs, and, with the addition of the putter, made ten clubs in all.  Loft gapping is 4 degrees between clubs, which is ideal, and models modern clubs today.  Of note, Gibson had two similar sets, the Star Maxwell (with its famous spiral holes in the neck) and the Momax, without the holes.  The Niblick from our set is a replica of the Gibson niblick. Note: we do sell the MacGregor niblick under the Niblick 8/OA, if that is preferred.   With the shorter sets, we've made an affordable playset for entry level players.  Customers can choose any of our clubs to comprise their five and eight club sets.  Feel free to reach out and talk to us, and we can develop a set together.  Note that you can always purchase more clubs to complete the set, so your initial investment can continue to hold value.

products.title: Golf Club Customization Fee
Star OA LH Mashie Hickory Iron
products.body_html:
This is a left handed club. The Star OA Hickory Irons are made to a vintage design popular in the early thirties, and have more 'bounce' than the Tom Morris irons.These irons are the finest manufactured today. Tad's commitment to the highest standards led him to work with the world renowned Otey Crisman III to manufacture the heart of the club, its Hickory shaft. Otey starts with the finest Hickory blanks and turns them to make a straight, strong, and playable shaft. The shafts then are taken and matched to the heads with modern adhesives and the old style pinned hosel to be sure the head and shaft are married together properly. After finishing the shaft the leather grip is hand wrapped on to give you, the player, the classic feel of a leather grip. This individual hand manufacturing insures you the finest club available today. These clubs are approved for hickory tournament play by the SoHG.

Loft 37º
Lie 61º
Length 37" hickory shaft
